# Morten Haulik

> Copenhagen-based XR pioneer, keynote speaker and XR consultant. Founder of NXT/WebXR, NXT/Care and MidwifeVR. Available for keynotes on VR, AR, mixed reality and smart glasses; XR strategy and development; XR marketing and advertising campaigns; and expert press comment, in English or Danish.

## Key pages

- [XR keynote speaker](https://www.mortenhaulik.com/xr-keynote-speaker/): talks, formats, stages, booking
- [XR consultant](https://www.mortenhaulik.com/xr-consultant/): strategy, prototypes, production, hardware advice
- [XR marketing & campaigns](https://www.mortenhaulik.com/xr-marketing-campaigns/): WebXR campaigns, VR/AR brand activations, agency partnerships
- [XR expert for press](https://www.mortenhaulik.com/xr-expert-press/): topics, previous coverage, press photos
- Danish: [Foredragsholder om VR](https://www.mortenhaulik.com/da/foredragsholder-vr/), [XR-konsulent](https://www.mortenhaulik.com/da/xr-konsulent/), [XR-markedsføring](https://www.mortenhaulik.com/da/xr-markedsfoering/), [VR-ekspert til presse](https://www.mortenhaulik.com/da/vr-ekspert-presse/)
- Other languages: [Deutsch](https://www.mortenhaulik.com/de/), [Italiano](https://www.mortenhaulik.com/it/), [Français](https://www.mortenhaulik.com/fr/)

## Facts

- More than a decade building XR; began on the early team at Khora in Copenhagen, one of Europe's first VR companies.
- Countless VR, AR and WebXR experiences for international brands, museums and cultural institutions, including lead development of an immersive journey into the kitchens of top Danish Michelin restaurants.
- Presented immersive work to members of the European Parliament and Commission and to UN delegations; 100+ industry workshops; audiences of 2,000+.
- Founder of NXT/WebXR (2025), one of the largest catalogues of WebXR games and experiences; his own games include HoloRange, Meows Freaky Fishstick Factory and die Hände.
- Founder of NXT/Care: mixed reality that calms children during blood tests, IV placement and dental visits in the Capital Region of Denmark.
- Co-founder of MidwifeVR (KU Impact Award 2021), now in the midwifery curriculum at University College Copenhagen.
- Entrepreneur in Residence at the University of Copenhagen (KU Lighthouse) since 2022.
- Keynote at IDA Driving Health Tech; panel at Future Sound Forum (Danish Sound Cluster) with Bang & Olufsen.
- Media: Berlingske (podcast Pilestræde), Radio4 Kulturmagasinet, DR2 So ein Ding, Voice of America, The Copenhagen Post, CBS Wire, 24Victoria.
